title: Engineer-UT Testing
qualification: Candidates applying for the post of Engineer (VC No. CL/08/26) must possess any one of the following: || Full-time Diploma in Mechanical/Metallurgical branch of Engineering with UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT),or || Full-time Degree in Mechanical/Metallurgical branch of Engineering with UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT) || The Diploma/Degree must be from an institution recognised by BTE/AICTE, or from a university incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India, or from an institution established/deemed under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to a Degree and recognised by AICTE, are also accepted. || Candidates from UR/EWS category (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts) must have a first-class degree or a minimum of 60% marks. Reserved category candidates applying against reserved posts must have at least 50% marks. Where the certificate or marksheet does not show a class/division or percentage, candidates must submit the CGPA/DGPA conversion formula issued by their university; where no such formula exists, an authorised undertaking is required, with a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale considered equivalent to 60%.
salary: This remuneration is indicative and reflects the approximate emoluments at the minimum of the pay-scale. The actual remuneration will depend on the place of posting and other terms and conditions of the appointment/company policy as revised from time to time.
age_limit: Age Relaxation: || SC/ST category: 5 years || OBC-NCL category: 3 years || Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years, in addition to any age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates, subject to the post being identified as suitable for PWD || PwBD candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the 10-year age relaxation, subject to meeting the identified physical requirements and functional classifications for the post (locomotor disability category, as specified in the official notification).
selection_process: The selection process consists of the following stages: || Document Scrutiny/Verification:All candidates who successfully submit the online application are provisionally allowed to appear for document scrutiny to verify their eligibility for the applied post. || Interview:Shortlisted/eligible candidates are called for an interview, which carries a weightage of100%- split as Technical & Professional proficiency (65%) and Personality, Communication & Competency (35%). || A minimum of 60% marks in the interview is required for UR/EWS candidates (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates against reserved posts) to be considered for placement on the panel; there is no separate minimum qualifying mark in the aggregate. RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for interview out of the eligible pool, and may conduct the written test, document verification, or interview from its Regional Offices as per requirement. Candidates may opt to appear for the interview in Hindi or English. Selected candidates must also be found medically fit as per RITES' Standards of Medical Fitness before final appointment.

title: Apprentice (ITI-Electrician, Diploma Electrical, Diploma Civil, Graduate Electrical, Graduate Civil)
qualification: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Civil Engineering (full-time, 4-year course) - not notified in SR-I
total_posts: 270 (computed by summing region-wise totals; see Vacancy section)
salary: The monthly stipend structure is uniform across all 10 regions, subject to satisfactory performance and attendance. || An additional ₹2,500 per month is payable if company accommodation is not provided or availed || The DBT portion is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme, subject to an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account || Apprentices are entitled to 12 days of Casual Leave (pro-rata) and 15 days of Medical Leave for the one-year duration, across all regions
age_limit: Minimum age: Candidates must have completed 18 years of age at the time of application, across all regions || Applicants must be Indian citizens and at least 18 years old at the time of application || No maximum age limit or age relaxation details are specified in any of the 10 regional notifications || Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.
selection_process: Applications are screened in merit order based on eligibility criteria and the qualification prescribed for each trade, region-wise || Incomplete or ineligible applications are summarily rejected without intimation || Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD is applied as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 || Candidates are called for document verification in a ratio of 1:5 against the notified training slots, in merit order || Shortlisted candidates are informed through their registered email; no TA/DA is paid for attending document verification || A final merit list is prepared from candidates found suitable after document verification || Selected candidates must accept a tripartite apprenticeship contract on the NATS/NAPS portal and submit a medical certificate and police verification before engagement || For PwBD candidates in Western Region-II, reservation/relaxation is subject to submission of a medical certificate for permanent disability, and only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the PwBD benefit
